summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Onboarding Wizard (Setup Guide) feature. Backend API GET /api/onboarding/step-status returns correct dynamic completion status. Frontend page at /admin/setup-guide displays all 5 steps with progress bar, left navigation, step details, action buttons, and channel cards. All navigation and functionality working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup Guide feature fully tested. Backend endpoint GET /api/onboarding/step-status dynamically checks: bot_instances for step 1, knowledge_sources for step 2, bot_config for step 3, conversations for step 4, discord_config/telegram_config/zendesk_config for step 5. Current admin account shows 4 of 5 steps complete (all except connect_channel). Frontend page at /admin/setup-guide has data-testid attributes: setup-guide-page, step-nav-{key}, wizard-action-{key}, wizard-channel-{label}, wizard-prev-btn, wizard-next-btn, wizard-done-btn, setup-guide-btn (sidebar).

features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='setup-guide-page', displays 5 steps with progress bar showing '4 of 5 steps complete'

features_tested.feature: Left sidebar shows step navigation with completion states
features_tested.details: All 5 step nav buttons found (create_instance, add_knowledge, customize_persona, test_bot, connect_channel). Completed steps show checkmarks and 'Complete' text, pending step shows 'Go live'

features_tested.feature: Clicking each step switches right panel content
features_tested.details: Each step shows title, description, tip, and action button. Step 5 shows 4 channel cards instead of single action button

features_tested.feature: Step 1 (Create Instance) shows 'Done' badge and navigates to /admin/instances
features_tested.details: Done badge visible, action button 'Go to Bot Instances' navigates correctly

features_tested.feature: Step 2 (Add Knowledge) shows 'Done' badge and navigates to /admin/knowledge
features_tested.details: Done badge visible, action button 'Open Knowledge Base' navigates correctly

features_tested.feature: Step 3 (Set Persona) shows 'Done' badge and navigates to /admin/settings
features_tested.details: Done badge visible, action button 'Open Bot Settings' navigates correctly

features_tested.feature: Step 4 (Test Bot) shows 'Done' badge and opens chat in new tab
features_tested.details: Done badge visible, action button 'Open Chat Demo' configured for external link (new tab)

features_tested.feature: Step 5 (Deploy Channel) shows 4 channel cards navigating to respective pages

features_tested.details: Previous disabled on step 1 (opacity=0.4), Next button advances steps, 'Go to Dashboard' button on step 5 navigates to /admin

features_tested.feature: Setup Guide link in sidebar bottom area
features_tested.details: NavLink with data-testid='setup-guide-btn' found, highlights when active (color: rgb(107, 170, 255))

features_tested.feature: Backend API GET /api/onboarding/step-status returns correct completion status
features_tested.details: Returns {create_instance: true, add_knowledge: true, customize_persona: true, test_bot: true, connect_channel: false} based on real data

api_verification.requires_instance_header: Optional (steps 2-5 require X-Instance-ID for accurate status)

response_format.create_instance: boolean - true if user has bot instances
response_format.add_knowledge: boolean - true if instance has knowledge sources
response_format.customize_persona: boolean - true if bot_config has name or system_prompt
response_format.test_bot: boolean - true if instance has conversations
